DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome

Based on the classic triad of a continuous heart murmur (likely PDA), bluish non-blanching macules (petechiae/purpura), and cloudy lenses (cataracts), along with the lack of immunization history, the diagnosis is clear. The failed auditory screening further supports this, as sensorineural deafness is a common manifestation.
